last.verdict: Investors cheered strong sales and a raised full-year outlook, shrugging off one-time tariff refunds.

reasons.label: Sales beat, more shoppers
reasons.text: Sales rose 5.3% to $26.5B, above forecasts, with customer traffic up 3.6%.

reasons.label: Raised full-year outlook
reasons.text: Sales growth now seen near 5%, a point higher. Profit guidance excluding refunds rose $0.75 at the midpoint.

reasons.label: Tariff refund flattered profit
reasons.text: A $994M tariff refund added $1.65 per share; excluding it, earnings rose 20%.

story: Target's sales fell through late 2025 (comparable sales down 2.7% in the fall, 2.5% in the winter). Growth returned in 2026, with comparable sales up 5.6% in spring and 3.8% now, and outlooks rose each time. The stock jumped after the March report but fell about 6% in May despite the beat.
